text: Decision (deal review, May 15): Pass on Coinbase (COIN) for now; revisit after the next print and clarity on the restructuring. Rationale: revenue remains concentrated in volatile crypto transaction fees; we want evidence of subscription & services diversification before initiating. Owner: Sarah Kim.

Risk note (deal review, May 15): Before sizing any COIN position, require (a) evidence of subscription & services mix expansion and (b) no signs of an insider exodus. Any initial position is a starter, capped at ~1% of NAV until a clean quarter confirms the diversification trend. Owner: Sarah Kim.

Screen note (Apr 20): Coinbase (COIN) flagged interesting on subscription & services growth and an improving regulatory posture; added to the watchlist. No action — monitor for a better entry and more evidence on revenue mix. Owner: Alex Rivera.
